info.title: Fourletters API - Hub (WebSocket)
info.description: Hub endpoints for WebSocket routing and E2E message delivery

get.description: Establish a WebSocket connection to the Hub for sending and receiving E2E encrypted messages. Authorization is evaluated statelessly via JWT.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Stateless Access JWT for authentication (standard WebSocket API limits custom headers, so query parameter is often used).

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing JWT token.
